Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: PvP cues, Smart Tab, responsive helpers, and survival tools.
Description: A local PvP HUD with nameplate cues, Limit Break alerts, pressure and CC information, Ping Helpers, medicine-kit beacons, range rings, a Wolves' Den map panel, recovery and job helpers, Smart Tab, assist macros, MP sounds, and target highlights.
Changelog: PLD Guardian now runs directly after Purify: exact 2+ focus opens it at 40% HP and 3+ at 50%, while generic Guard must remain ready for self-protection. Smart Action now lets metadata-verified Shield Smite/Schildhieb and Chain Stratagem/Kritische Strategie select Guard; other Guard/Cover/PLD-LB/DRK-LB actors are skipped, and only Chiten can veto incidental AoE. Target-independent Smart Action Chase in CC now remembers the best safe S1-S5 enemy plus the exact ability without changing target or reranking. /seitonfar remains reachable-only. Auto-Zantetsuken requires exactly one current own Kuzushi. Automated checks are separate from live in-game confirmation.
